title.narrative: Health Equity and Financial Protection Platform (ProtectHealth)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .USAID, through the ProtectHealth activity, strengthens the country's health financing systems to enhance financial protection and equitable access to health services. USAID supports the implementation of the Universal Health Care (UHC) law by introducing and institutionalizing key reforms to address financing policy bottlenecks, which have been exacerbated by the socio-economic impacts of COVID-19. USAID also builds the capacity to collect, analyze, and use information to develop and implement evidence-based health financing programs within the Department of Health (DOH) and the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth)...TB and family planning-earmarked funds will support the following interventions:.Support the DOH to update its Medium-Term Expenditure Program 2023-2026 as a guide in the annual development of the National Expenditure Program. Build DOH capacity for public financial management and for rationalizing provision of technical and financial support to priority provinces and cities. This includes support for the development of performance-based grants and the multi-year investment plan for health. Help PhilHealth implement the Benefit Development Plan to rationalize the process of introducing and rolling out benefits and develop a monitoring system for the financial viability of the National Health Insurance Program, including the provision of benefits. Assist the enhancement and optimization of Benefit Packages for tuberculosis, family planning, and HIV. Support the DOH and PhilHealth in developing a financing and governance model for UHC implementation in selected UHC integration sites to demonstrate a functional Special Health Fund that optimizes financial resources for service delivery. Improve the documentation of learning activities in 12 priority UHC integration sites supported by USAID as inputs to policy and operational enhancements of UHC implementation.. .. .. .
